title: Microsoft PowerToys adds Alt+Tab-style switching for an app's windows
summary: Microsoft updated its Windows PowerToys toolset with a new utility dubbed "Window Hopper" that lets users switch between an app's windows more quickly. The Blue Report 2026 measures defenses technique by technique across 338 million simulations run in customer production environments.
